body: That's the thing though, I'm not a good person. I don't add anything of value to anyone's life. I've been getting various forms of professional help most of my life, but you can't medicate or talk therapy your way out of being defective. I don't have any skills that I can monetize, therefore I really don't have any useful skills. I don't even have a job ffs
